proceso.titulo: 100% Remote Assisted Reset via USB connection
proceso.introTexto: Here's how the connection works before you message us on WhatsApp:
proceso.paso1Texto: You need a PC with Windows 11, 10, or 8. Open WhatsApp Web on that same computer and connect your printer with a USB cable. You'll also need to download the secure connection module.
proceso.paso2Texto: Open the program and enter the technician ID shown below. In "Additional information", type your name.
proceso.paso3Texto: Unplug the printer's USB cable, wait 5 seconds, and plug it back in so it can be detected correctly.
proceso.paso4Titulo: Contact us on WhatsApp for your free online review
proceso.paso4Texto: Message us with your printer's brand, model, and error. We'll evaluate your case at no cost and confirm if the assisted reset applies.

comoFuncionaProceso.introParrafo1: Printers have an internal print counter. When this counter reaches 100% (known as the ink pad error or 5B00), we reset it back to 0% to unlock your printer in under 1 minute — no taking it anywhere, no waiting for a home visit, and no strangers installing anything on your PC or disabling your antivirus.
comoFuncionaProceso.introParrafo2: Our Assisted Reset means a real technician guides you over WhatsApp and creates a secure bridge through your USB cable to do the work from our server.
comoFuncionaProceso.introDestacado: You just plug in the cable — we handle the technical work!
comoFuncionaProceso.introAclaracion: Important note: we don't sell self-service programs. We deliver a direct solution to your printer's board.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficiosSubtitulo: Speed, proven track record, and zero risk — that's how we get your printer working again today.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio1Texto: The fix runs ultra-fast. Your printer ready in 60 seconds or less once connected.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio2Texto: No need to take your printer anywhere or schedule a technician visit. Forget waiting days — the fix is immediate.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio3Texto: Total privacy. No heavy programs to install, and no one remotely controlling your PC.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio4Texto: A clean, virus-free process. You never need to disable your antivirus.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio5Texto: Total confidence. We have over 920 five-star ratings from real, satisfied customers.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio6Texto: Zero risk. If after trying every technical means we can't fix the error, we refund your money.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio7Texto: Get 12 months of coverage (extendable to 15). Reusable license: applies from any PC for printers of the same model.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio8Texto: Professional, human technical support, always available whenever your business needs it most.
comoFuncionaProceso.beneficio9Texto: We reward our community. Join our daily giveaways for discount coupons and FREE Resets!

faq.title: Frequently asked questions | ResetEnLinea.com
faq.description: We answer the most common questions about printer resets and our assistance process.
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions

items.pregunta: Does this site offer a free program to reset my printer myself?
items.respuesta: No. We don't distribute free reset programs or self-service tools. This is a 100% assisted service: a real technician guides you over WhatsApp through the whole process.

items.pregunta: Is it safe to reset my printer?
items.respuesta: Yes. We work with a prior diagnosis and professional guidance throughout the procedure.

items.pregunta: Is it safe to share my printer's USB connection?
items.respuesta: Yes. We only share your printer's USB connection: we never see your screen, access your files, or control your computer. You stay in control at all times.

items.pregunta: Do I need to disable my antivirus?
items.respuesta: No. We never ask you to disable your antivirus or any security system on your device.

items.pregunta: What do I need for remote assistance?
items.respuesta: A stable internet connection and your printer connected to your computer via USB.
We first evaluate your case and confirm that your model and error are compatible. Only after that confirmation do we quote the price and arrange payment.

items.pregunta: Do I get any proof of the service?
items.respuesta: Yes. Once the reset is done, you receive a warranty certificate for the service performed.

items.pregunta: What if my device doesn't meet the requirements?
items.respuesta: We evaluate alternatives, including a local procedure guided over a USB connection.

objeto.p1Fuerte: 100% Remote Assisted Reset via USB Connection
objeto.p1Despues: . ResetEnLinea does not sell software, licenses, or reset programs. The technical tools used while providing the service are merely a means of delivering it, not the product being contracted.

naturaleza.p1: ResetEnLinea's technician does not access the client's computer. The client only temporarily shares their printer's USB port through the corresponding connection tool.
naturaleza.p2Despues: . This tool only establishes communication between the client's printer and the server where the technician works. The reset itself is performed remotely by the technician, without accessing the client's equipment beyond that printer connection.

reembolsos.p1: Before payment is confirmed, a technical review is carried out to verify the equipment's compatibility with the contracted service.
reembolsos.li1: If, following that review, the equipment turns out not to be compatible, a refund applies.
reembolsos.li2: If the procedure fails to complete the contracted reset, a refund applies.
reembolsos.li3Antes: Once the reset is deemed successful,
reembolsos.p2: The reset is considered successful when the counter covered by the service has been reset and the specific contracted error has been cleared. Resetting does not mean repairing.

exclusiones.titulo: 5. What the service does not include
exclusiones.intro: The Assisted Reset service does not include, among other things:
items: Physical repair, physical cleaning, or physical maintenance of the equipment
Repair of printers that do not power on
Print quality issues (blurry or blank printouts)
In general, any type of physical repair

errores.nota: These codes do not automatically mean that any model is compatible. Compatibility depends on the specific model and must be confirmed before payment is made.

garantia.p1: The service warranty may run from 3 to 12 months. The exact duration applicable to each service is set out in the corresponding certificate.
garantia.p2: As a promotional offer, ResetEnLinea may extend the warranty by an additional 1 month, up to a maximum of 2 additional months.
garantia.p3: The warranty applies specifically to the reset of the contracted model and does not constitute a comprehensive warranty covering the printer or its other components.
garantia.p4: While the warranty remains valid, the client may request the service for another printer of the same model, provided that it involves:
garantia.legal: RECOMMENDED LEGAL REVIEW — conditions for transferring/reusing the warranty.

certificado.p1: The certificate is the document that evidences the warranty for the service provided. It may be delivered in PDF format, as a photograph, or in printed form.
certificado.p2: If the client does not provide an email address, the certificate cannot be sent to them by that means.

evidencia.p1: After a successful reset, ResetEnLinea may generate video evidence of the service performed. This evidence may be used as social proof and published on ResetEnLinea's channels, including this website.

privacidad.p1: An uncensored, private version of the conversation with the client exists and may form part of the warranty certificate delivered to them. The version published publicly is censored, protecting the client's personal data.
privacidad.p2: Public publication of conversations, videos, or service evidence is handled through an authorization separate from these Terms and Conditions.
privacidad.p3Antes: If, after a public posting, the client requests its removal, they may do so by writing to
privacidad.legal: RECOMMENDED LEGAL REVIEW — processing of personal data and image/publication authorization.
